content: The text provided is a dense and highly technical compilation of clinical trial data, treatment regimens, and quality assessments for various studies involving antiviral therapies, particularly for hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment. 1. In 2016, a study evaluated the combination of daclatasvir (DAC) for 24 weeks with asunaprevir (ASV) for 24 weeks. The treatment was effective, and the study included ledipasvir (LDV) for 12 weeks combined with sofosbuvir (SOF) for 12 weeks. 2. Another 2016 study assessed DAC at a dose of 60 mg daily for 24 weeks combined with ASV at 100 mg twice daily for 24 weeks. The treatment was successful. 3. In 2017, DAC (60 mg daily) combined with ASV (100 mg twice daily) for 24 weeks was again evaluated, showing positive outcomes. 4. A 2017 study investigated LDV (90 mg daily) combined with SOF (400 mg daily) for 12 weeks. The treatment was effective. 5. Another 2017 study examined DAC (60 mg daily) with ASV (100 mg twice daily) for 24 weeks, yielding favorable results. 6. The ION-1 trial (NCT01701401) evaluated LDV (90 mg) and SOF (400 mg) for 12 weeks and 24 weeks. Both regimens were effective. 7. The ION-2 trial (NCT01768286) also assessed LDV (90 mg) and SOF (400 mg) for 12 and 24 weeks, demonstrating efficacy. 8. The ION-3 trial (NCT01851330) compared LDV (90 mg) and SOF (400 mg) for 8 weeks and 12 weeks, with both regimens showing success. 9. The ION-4 trial (NCT02073656) evaluated SOF (400 mg) and LDV (90 mg) for 12 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 10. A 2016 study by Isakov assessed LDV (90 mg daily) and SOF (400 mg daily) for 8 weeks, with positive results. 11. Ishigami (2017) evaluated DAC and ASV, confirming the treatment's success. 12. Iwamoto (2017) studied elbasvir (ESV) daily for 12 weeks combined with grazoprevir (GZR) daily for 12 weeks, showing efficacy. 13. Another study in 2016 assessed DAC for 12 weeks combined with SOF for 12 weeks, as well as DAC for 24 weeks with SOF for 24 weeks. Both regimens were effective. 14. The 2017 study by Jargalsaikhan evaluated LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, confirming efficacy. 15. Johnson (2017) assessed DAC (60 mg daily) with SOF (400 mg daily) for 12 weeks, as well as LDV (90 mg daily) with SOF (400 mg daily) for 12 weeks. Both regimens were effective. 16. Kawada (2015) evaluated ESV (50 mg daily) with GZR (50 mg daily) for 12 weeks, as well as ESV (50 mg daily) with GZR (100 mg daily) for 12 weeks. Both regimens were successful. 17. Kawakami (2016) studied DAC (60 mg daily) with ASV (100 mg twice daily) for 24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 18. Kumada (2014, 2016) conducted multiple studies evaluating DAC (60 mg daily) with ASV (100 mg twice daily) for 24 weeks, showing consistent success. 19. Kwo (2016) assessed grazoprevir (300 mg daily) with paritaprevir (120 mg daily) for 12 weeks, demonstrating effectiveness. 20. Lawitz (2017) evaluated SOF (400 mg daily) with velpatasvir (VEL, 100 mg daily) and voxilaprevir (VOX, 100 mg daily) for 12 weeks, confirming efficacy. 21. Liu (2017) studied DAC for 24 weeks combined with SOF for 24 weeks, with or without ribavirin (RBV), showing positive outcomes. 22. Lok (2012) evaluated DAC (60 mg daily) with ASV (600 mg twice daily) for 24 weeks, confirming success. 23. The LONESTAR trial (NCT01726517) assessed LDV and SOF for 12 weeks and 8 weeks, both regimens being effective. 24. The MAGELLAN-1 trial (NCT02446717) evaluated grazoprevir (200-300 mg daily) with paritaprevir (80-120 mg daily) for 12-16 weeks, showing efficacy. 25. The MALACHITE-I trial (NCT01854697) assessed paritaprevir/ritonavir (150/100 mg daily) with ombitasvir (25 mg daily) and dasabuvir (250 mg twice daily) for 12 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 26. Mangia (2016, 2017) conducted studies evaluating DAC and SOF for 12-24 weeks, as well as SOF with RBV for 16-20 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 27. Mehta (2017) assessed LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, as well as DAC and SOF for 12-24 weeks, with or without RBV, confirming efficacy. 28. Mizokami (2015) evaluated LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, showing success. 29. Nagao (2017) studied LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 30. Nguyen (2017) assessed LDV and SOF for 8-12 weeks, showing positive results. 31. Ogawa (2016, 2017) evaluated SOF with RBV for 12 weeks, as well as DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 32. The ONYX-I trial assessed paritaprevir/ritonavir with ombitasvir and dasabuvir for 12 weeks, showing success. 33. The PEARL trials (II, III, IV) evaluated paritaprevir/ritonavir with ombitasvir and dasabuvir for 12 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 34. Persico (2017) studied LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 35. The PHOTON-2 trial (NCT01783678) evaluated SOF with RBV for 12-24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 36. Pianko (2015) assessed SOF with velpatasvir for 12 weeks, showing success. 37. The POLARIS trials (1-4) evaluated SOF with velpatasvir and voxilaprevir for 8-12 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 38. The POSITRON trial (NCT01542788) assessed SOF with RBV for 12 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 39. Reddy (2017) evaluated DAC with ASV, confirming efficacy. 40. Sezaki (2017) studied DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, showing success. 41. Shah (2016) assessed SOF with RBV for 16-24 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 42. Shih (2017) evaluated LDV and SOF for 8-12 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 43. The SIRIUS trial (NCT01965535) assessed SOF with LDV for 24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 44. Suda (2016, 2017) studied DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, showing success. 45. Sung (2016) evaluated DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 46. The SURVEYOR trials (I, II) assessed grazoprevir with paritaprevir for 8-12 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 47. Suzuki (2017) studied DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 48. The SYNERGY trial (NCT01805882) evaluated LDV and SOF for 12 weeks, showing success. 49. Terashita (2017) assessed DAC with ASV, confirming effectiveness. 50. Torres (2017) evaluated LDV with SOF, as well as SOF with velpatasvir, showing positive outcomes. 51. Toyoda (2016, 2017) studied DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, confirming efficacy. 52. The TURQUOISE-III trial (NCT02219503) assessed paritaprevir/ritonavir with ombitasvir and dasabuvir for 12 weeks, showing success. 53. The UNITY trial (NCT02123654) evaluated DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 54. The VALENCE trial (NCT01682720) assessed SOF with RBV for 12-24 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 55. The VALOR-HCV trial (NCT02128542) evaluated SOF with RBV for 12 weeks, confirming efficacy. 56. The VASCUVALDIC trial (NCT02856243) studied DAC with SOF for 12-24 weeks, showing success. 57. Vierling (2015) evaluated ESV with GZR for 8 weeks, confirming effectiveness. 58. Wei (2016, 2017) assessed DAC with ASV for 24 weeks, as well as SOF with RBV for 12-24 weeks, showing positive outcomes. 59. Yakoot (2017) evaluated generic DAC with SOF for 12 weeks, confirming efficacy. 60. Younossi (2016) studied LDV with SOF for 12 weeks, showing success. 61. Zeng (2017) assessed generic LDV with SOF for 8 weeks, confirming effectiveness.
